notes: Rare cosmetic drops from Hot Zone monsters and chests (Hythloth has its own pool). Five themes so the loot matches the killer: undead and graveyard (sarcophagi, coffins), bones and candles, dragon hoards, shadowiron and dark relics, and dark arcana (rite tables, grimoires, bloody altars). 'tier' is the catalog tier and can be used as drop rarity (three extremely-rare: the ornate sarcophagus, the dragon's hoard and the twin bloodstained altars). 'theme' lets a system roll from the right group (undead corpse, dragon corpse, chest). Three entries are era grade C: the dragon hoards are the only hoard art of that kind in the catalog, and the pool would feel hollow without them. Nothing here is mentioned as a Nemesis trophy, a Wanted curator item or a shipwreck piece.
